entry_updates.mechanism_append: Source-read conformance support: `WireChannel` supplies send, sendFragmented and close promises. `ProtocolTestClient` encodes client messages with the same codec and accumulates messages returned by ServerMessageDecoder. hello waits for hello/hello_error; request allocates request-N unless an id is supplied, registers a matching response waiter before sending, then returns that response. next/nextFrom may reuse an already recorded matching message; otherwise a closed client rejects and an open client registers a waiter. receive resolves all matching waiters for each decoded message. fail rejects/clears current waiters without setting closed; markClosed is idempotent, sets closed, resolves waitForClose and rejects remaining waiters. It does not call decoder.end on close. These exported fixtures are test support for this protocol contract, not an additional production client implementation (ice:packages/server/src/testing/client.ts:20-114).
entry_updates.interfaces_append: The explicitly named schema/type exports in field 2 are the existing version-one vocabulary. Text is `{type:'text',text:string}`; thinking adds optional redacted:boolean; image requires string data and nonempty mimeType; toolCall uses nonempty toolCallId/toolName plus JSON input. Model cost requires four nonnegative numeric rates, and usage requires five nonnegative integer token totals plus five nonnegative numeric costs, with optional nonnegative reasoning count. `ResultForCommand` selects the list result, detach result or the matching discriminated command result; it does not introduce a different wire response. Decoder factories construct the existing ClientMessageDecoder/ServerMessageDecoder with optional frame options, and isSupportedProtocolVersion requires Number.isInteger plus equality to 1 (ice:packages/protocol/src/schemas.ts:54-118; ice:packages/protocol/src/schemas.ts:374-378; ice:packages/protocol/src/codec.ts:162-172).

`AssistantTranscriptOptions` and `UserTranscriptOptions` each require id:string; `ToolTranscriptOptions` additionally requires call:ToolCall. These are projection inputs, not optional transcript wire fields (ice:packages/server/src/protocol.ts:108-119).

Source-read conformance support: TEST_MODEL is test/small, display Test Small, API test-api, reasoning enabled, text+image input, contextWindow16000/maxTokens2000, four zero costs, supported levels off/medium/high and authenticated:true. This is a synthetic test catalog row. TestSessionRuntime clones snapshots, keeps a pending prompt latch, appends a user item and enters turn, then appends `reply:<text>`/complete or an empty aborted assistant when the latch resolves. Steer requires non-idle, records the input and queued user item/count; abort resolves a pending latch or throws busy. Model/thinking setters require idle. update increments revision/updatedAt and emits snapshot; helper emit methods notify live listener sets directly. dispose increments disposeCount on each call, invokes its unlock callback and resolves a disposal latch, without implementing its own once-only guard (ice:packages/server/src/testing/backend.ts:19-31; ice:packages/server/src/testing/backend.ts:52-191).

TestSessionBackend keeps in-memory stored snapshots/runtime history/lock IDs, can pause exactly the next list call with entered/release latches, returns the synthetic model, and seeds deterministic idle revision-zero snapshots. Create rejects an existing id, open rejects missing/locked ids, and acquire records a new runtime whose disposal removes the lock. The fixture default cwd is `/tmp/ice-server-conformance`; no filesystem read/write is performed by this in-memory helper. These exports are conformance scaffolding for the backend/runtime boundary, without adding a production storage or model capability (ice:packages/server/src/testing/backend.ts:198-292).
